lines.text: Tang galiyon ki is bheed mein
Pao mere thak se gaye the
Puranay sheeshe ki aik dukan par
Kadam achanak ruk se gaye the
Kaanch ke tukde par chamki nazar
Aks tumhara wahan dikha
Mudh ke dekha na tha abhi tak
Par dil mera wahi bik gaya

lines.text: Ruk gayi hawa, thak gaya samaa
Ek hi pal mein badla jahan
Sunno na...
Aaine mein dekha pehli baar tumhein
Ho gaya pehli nazar mein pyar tumhein
Dhanak se rang sab khil gaye
Jab se hum is mod par mil gaye
(Ho gaya pyar tumhein... ho gaya pyar...)

lines.text: Kaan ki baali jab hili tumhari
Dhadkan meri bhi tezz hui
Bazaar ki rounak phiki lagi
Sirf tumhari aahat azeez hui
Mudh ke dekha toh tum thi samne
Jhulfein hawa mein lehra rahi thi
Har baat jo main kehna chahta tha
Tumhari ankhein bata rahi thi
